name: ferpa
description: Monorepo template — pnpm workspaces + Vite + React + TypeScript + TanStack Query + Zustand + Tailwind.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @ferpa/data-model build && pnpm --filter @ferpa/ui build && pnpm --filter @ferpa/web dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ferpa/data-model build && pnpm --filter @ferpa/ui build && pnpm --filter @ferpa/web build
